title: Welcome to your collaborative Todo List!
description: This app is fully connected to an Axum backend. Any changes you make are saved in real-time across devices.

title: Explore filtering and sorting capabilities
description: You can filter tasks by Category (Work, Personal, Shopping, etc.), search by text, or filter by Priority.

title: Try out real-time sync
description: Open this app in multiple browser tabs. Notice the sync indicator and watch how changes propagate smoothly.
